name: Poison Path
desc:
☠️ Don’t stand where the Poison walked… ☠️

In Poison Path, one player becomes the Poison.
When the lights go out, everyone runs while the Poison secretly leaves a deadly trail.

💡 Lights on… FREEZE!
🧪 The Poison’s path is revealed
💀 Anyone standing on it is eliminated
🏃 Survive the round
☠️ Become the Poison
🔥 Last survivor wins
